h1: The 5 Best 90-to-100-Inch TVs of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best 90 to 100 Inch TVs 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the best 90 to 100 inch TVs, compared on screen size, refresh rate and panel type, plus one 85 inch step-down option.
summary: The Hisense 100-Inch E6 is our best overall for its 100 inch QLED screen and 144Hz refresh rate. The Samsung 98-Inch DU9000 is the pick for 120Hz at a slightly smaller footprint, and the TCL 98-Inch Q65 is a QLED alternative running Google TV. The Samsung 85-Inch U8000H is a step-down if 90 inches will not fit.
intro: Buying a TV near 100 inches fails more often on the tape measure than on the picture. A 98 inch panel is roughly 85 inches wide, and it has to get through your door, up your stairs and onto a wall or stand that can take it. Plan the delivery path before you plan the picture.

We reviewed the 90 to 100 inch TVs available here, plus one 85 inch model as a flagged fallback, ranking them on screen size, refresh rate, panel type and smart platform. Our source data is thin on picture-quality specs, so we kept claims to what the listings state.

products.name: Hisense 100" Class E6 Series QLED 4K UHD Smart Fire TV (100E6QF
products.verdict: The biggest screen here, with a 144Hz refresh rate on QLED.
products.description:
The Hisense E6 is a 100 inch QLED 4K Smart Fire TV, and it lists a 144Hz refresh rate. That makes it the largest screen in this ranking and the only one stating 144Hz.

It ranks first because it pairs the top end of the size range with the highest stated refresh rate. Next to the Samsung DU9000, it gives you two more inches and 24 more hertz, though neither of us can vouch for it beyond the listing.

Buy it if you want the biggest screen and care about gaming-friendly refresh. The caveat is that it sits in the $500+ bracket and 100 inches is a delivery and wall challenge.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the largest screen and a high refresh rate.
products.skipIf: Your room or doorway cannot take a 100 inch set.

products.name: Samsung 98-Inch Class 4K Crystal UHD DU9000 Series HDR Smart TV
products.verdict: A 98 inch Crystal UHD with 120Hz and HDR.
products.description:
The Samsung DU9000 is a 98 inch Crystal UHD 4K Smart TV with HDR and a stated 120Hz refresh rate.

It ranks second because it offers a slightly smaller footprint than the 100 inch Hisense, which helps in a limited space, while still giving a high refresh rate. It is an LED Crystal UHD model, whereas the Hisense and TCL list QLED.

Choose it for a big screen with 120Hz in a slightly tighter room. The caveat is that the listing does not state QLED.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a big screen with a smaller footprint.

products.name: TCL 98-Inch Q65 QLED 4K UHD Smart TV with Google TV (98Q651G
products.verdict: A 98 inch QLED running Google TV.
products.description:
The TCL Q65 is a 98 inch QLED 4K UHD Smart TV with Google TV built in. The listing does not state a refresh rate.

It ranks third because the Hisense and the Samsung DU9000 both list high refresh rates, while the TCL does not. It does offer QLED at 98 inches with the Google TV interface.

Buy it if you prefer Google TV. The caveat is that there is no stated refresh rate, so gamers should look elsewhere.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want QLED and Google TV.
products.skipIf: High refresh rate is a priority.

products.name: Samsung 98-Inch Class QLED Q7F Series Samsung Vision AI Smart TV
products.verdict: A 98 inch Samsung QLED with Vision AI features.
products.description:
The Samsung Q7F is a 98 inch QLED Smart TV with Samsung Vision AI. Our data does not list its refresh rate or a price bracket.

It ranks fourth because it states less than the Hisense and DU9000, though it is the Samsung option here with QLED. It sits alongside the DU9000 in size.

Choose it if you want Samsung and QLED together. The caveat is that you should confirm the refresh rate and current price before buying.
products.idealFor: Samsung buyers who want QLED at 98 inches.
products.skipIf: You need a confirmed refresh rate.

products.name: Samsung 85-Inch Class U8000H Series Crystal UHD
products.verdict: An 85 inch fallback if a 98 inch set will not fit.
products.description:
The Samsung U8000H is an 85 inch Crystal UHD 4K TV. It is below the 90 inch floor of this guide, so we include it only as a fallback.

It ranks last because it does not meet the size range, and the listing states only the 85 inch size and 4K. It is the most practical option when delivery or room size rules out 98 inches.

Choose it if a 98 or 100 inch set will not fit. The caveat is that it is not a true 90 to 100 inch TV.
products.idealFor: Buyers whose room cannot take a 98 inch set.
products.skipIf: You need a screen of 90 inches or more.

whatMatters.detail: A 98 inch TV is roughly 85 inches wide, which is wider than many walls and doorways allow. Measure doors, hallways and stairs before ordering. Compare the listed dimensions with your path.
Refresh rate is how many times per second the screen updates. 120Hz and 144Hz suit gaming and fast sports. Look for the hertz figure in the title or bullets.
QLED and Crystal UHD are different LED-based technologies. QLED uses a quantum-dot layer, and Crystal UHD does not. The listing names the type, so confirm it.
Fire TV, Google TV and Samsung's own system differ in apps and layout. Pick the one you already know. The platform is named in the product title.
A TV this size needs a strong wall mount or a wide stand. Check the weight and VESA details on the listing. Plan for two people to lift it.

faq.q: Will a 98 inch TV fit through my door?
faq.a: Measure first. A 98 inch TV is roughly 85 inches wide on the diagonal, so check doorways and stairs.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make at this size?
faq.a: They plan the picture but not the delivery. Measure the path and wall before ordering.

faq.q: Is the Hisense worth it over the Samsung DU9000?
faq.a: If you want two more inches and a stated 144Hz, yes. The Samsung is a slightly smaller footprint.

faq.q: How do I set up a TV this large?
faq.a: Use a heavy-duty wall mount or a wide stand and bring a helper. Follow the manual for weight guidance.

faq.q: How do I maintain a large screen?
faq.a: Dust with a microfiber cloth and avoid sprays. Check the manual for cleaning advice.
It is a practical fallback, but it is below the 90 inch range of this guide.

finalTake: The Hisense 100-Inch E6 is the best pick for buyers who want the largest screen and a high refresh rate. The Samsung DU9000 is the smaller-footprint alternative, and the TCL Q65 suits Google TV fans. Check delivery and mounting before you click buy.
